ratings.comment: So you're liking C++. You have Zylabs to refer to. But that soon gets pulled out from under you and you are mostly stuck with extensive lecture replays. She really means well and even dropped our two lowest lab scores, but running code is a way different beast from understanding material. Also the "no code" stinginess on Piazza goes way too far.
ratings.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

ratings.comment: She hadnt taught 460 before and was using another prof old curriculum, but she didnt seem to understand the material herself, or at least had a very difficult time conveying it. The assignments were all confusing and she was a tough grader. I feel like I learned nothing and dealt with an excessive amount of stress in this class.

Dr. Taneja in CS 425 is Dr. Taneja at her best (this field is her specialty)! I took 425 during Covid and she was my only prof to successfully implement 100% async classwork. Material was great and she managed to get a grant so her students could access a supercomputer! I did poorly because I slacked- if this is you, beware. You must earn your A.
ratings.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

ratings.comment: Felt like she was learning the material as she went along, lectures were rambly/confusing/full of mistakes. HORRIBLE communication about exams/projects/HW (blamed us for not starting early with zero info on what to do). Used archaic, unreadable scripts for "feedback" and actually graded maybe 2 assignments all semester. Very disappointing.

Ridiculous. Video lectures consisted of reading from slides with little to no elaboration. Project specifications were unclear and full of grammatical and spelling errors that obstructed the actual goal of the project and created confusion. Acted in a disrespectful and curt way to students often. Avoid if possible.

Dr. Taneja is a gem at SSU. She cares about the subject, and knows what she's talking about. Her lecture videos were super helpful, and the live lectures were a great chance to learn more and ask questions. She's super helpful during office hours and a great person to just chat with. Can't recommend her enough, hope I get to take her again.
Hard end of the year labs Hard exams. Easy homework.

Labs at the end of the year were obviously rushed and had very poor directions, SAD! Prepare yourself to become a google-fu master b/c you will need to teach yourself for a good amount of the content. Exited with return code -11 (SIGSEGV)

Dr Taneja is really kind and seems passionate about being a good professor, but she seems like she is still figuring out her teaching style. However, she is clearly very smart, and she structured her class is a very logical way, and I do feel like I learned a lot.

Caring Professor, willing to work with you, takes feedback and acts on it. Her lectures, in my opinion are somewhat sub-par, but It might just be my difficulty in understanding the concepts. She does her best outside of her lectures (Office hours, email) to ensure you understand whatever material you're covering.

Professor Shubbhi is an awesome teacher. She will work with you if you are willing to put in the effort and learn. I got a 0/100 (which is a lot to miss) on one of my HW assignments and I was still able to pull out with an A because of how willing she was to help me succeed.

Dr. Taneja is an excellent professor. She makes an extreme effort to be clear with students. If you do not understand something, ask, she will appreciate your interest. Do your homework early, the second HW is deceptively hard. A gem within SSU.

Dr. Taneja is 100% awesome 95% of the time. She's very thorough, caring, gives tons practice and examples, and is extremely accessible. Attend every class, take excellent notes, START HW ON TIME and you'll get an A. Rigorous tests, sometimes brutal hw, long and difficult group project. Beware- friendly, but not slacker-friendly. Don't mess around.
